user_convention.approaches: Both incoming native lanes kept separately; clear if any sampled body ray is clear within a direction.
user_convention.near: Demonstrate actual turn placement within the native surveyed crest profile and original crest-surface ray hits; no universal proximity cutoff or human-perception requirement.
